items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I saw when I was coming up Les band, there was a very strong guy named Jack Trainer.

ctx.x: And then it happened again in New York, somebody put a gun on me. And -- I know what it was. I saw when I was coming up Les band, there was a very strong guy named Jack Trainer. (Unintelligible) in his pocket, you didn't know whether it was a gun or not. And he really grabbed the guy and turned him around to face the wall and jammed him into the wall. And maybe that might have got to me.
You mean you figured that was a kind of an act that people would notice, huh?
